name: Sea Cliffs
desc: A drowned coast of headlands stepping back into haze — five capes enter from alternating sides and overlap like stage flats, each rank paler and further off, their seaward faces dropping in strata to a cold working sea where swell lines roll toward the base and foam pulses white at the foot of every cliff; overcast grass-topped headland, low gold-hour, moonlit nocturne, sumi ink silhouettes, or a cyan nautical chart.

energy.doc: how hard the light and water work — rim light, foam brightness, swell contrast

scale.doc: how monumental the cliffs are — face height, cape size, foam scale (rebuilds the coast)

density.doc: how many strata bands, swell lines and foam bursts

speed.doc: swell, cloud scroll and foam rate

surf.doc: how heavy the sea is — foam and spray at the cliff feet

haze.doc: how thick the aerial haze is — how far back the ranks fade

hue.doc: palette hue shift off the default grey-green coast

x.doc: which way the light rakes across the cliff faces

y.doc: the sea horizon — low y gives more sky, high y more water

style.doc: aesthetic: headland = overcast grey-green grass-topped cliffs, cold slate sea; goldhour = warm low sun on the faces, glittering water; nocturne = moonlit blue-silver near-monochrome; ink = sumi ink-wash silhouette ranks; chart = cyan nautical survey, contour soundings, no photo shading

act.doc: multi-minute programme — a calm sea, a heavy swell building the surf over sections, or fog rolling in and swallowing the far ranks

seed.doc: regenerates the cape profiles, strata, cloud band and foam

alpha.doc: how far the world sits back behind the performers
